state.objective: Select online versus maintenance window migration for shard 7.

context.content: Shard 7 contains 4.8TB data, 12,000 IOPS write load. Maintenance window allows max 30 min downtime; full pg_dump/restore requires 6 hours.
Logical replication CDC via Debezium supports cutover in <15 seconds once caught up.
Hardware: AWS r6i.4xlarge instances with gp3 EBS volumes.

submitted_answer.answer: Use online logical replication/CDC for shard 7.
